checkpoint_selection.candidate_policy: evaluate checkpoint-1000, checkpoint-2000, and the completed final adapter for each SFT arm on the main validation fixture; evaluate only the separate English supplement for the English-retention gate
checkpoint_selection.selection_rule: highest macro intent accuracy among candidates passing every primary and gross-stop gate

final_test.run_policy: run exactly once for the frozen base model and exactly once for each validation-selected SFT checkpoint

gross_stop.empty_output_definition: raw_response is empty after whitespace stripping
gross_stop.repetition_definition: rep4 = 1 - unique whitespace-tokenized 4-grams / all 4-grams; severe iff rep4 > 0.3

selection_rule: validation-only selection; the frozen test fixture is reporting-only
